name: Obsidian Shelf
author: tmn73
description: Lists from your Obsidian vault in the bar: links to read later, todos and retro topics, captured on your phone and handled from the desktop.

barWidget.description: Read later links, todos and retro topics from a Markdown vault. Open, tick, add and clear without opening Obsidian.

schema.label: Vault folder
schema.description: The folder that holds your lists, usually your Obsidian vault.

schema.label: Sync check command
schema.description: Optional. A shell command that exits 0 while your sync works. The chip shows a dot when it fails.
